entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: A realm of Kaldheim, at the center of the calamity when the realms crashed together and invaded by demons of Immersturm.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: The calamity in which the realms crashed together.

entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: A sword that cuts through the Cosmos itself, carving new Omenpaths between the realms.

entities.name: The Cosmos
entities.description: The cosmic structure that holds the realms of Kaldheim.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths between the realms of Kaldheim.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: A figure who united the spirits of all the clans into a single force.

entities.name: Sigrid
entities.description: A god-favored warrior, never alone and never afraid.

entities.name: Hakka
entities.description: Alrund's raven, who soars between realms.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: A god of Kaldheim whose raven is Hakka.

entities.name: Littjara
entities.description: A realm where masks float downstream toward the Mirrorlake.

entities.name: Mirrorlake
entities.description: A lake where faces arise to wear the masks floating toward it.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: Realm of demons who poured into Bretagard.

entities.name: Egon
entities.description: The God of Death, who ages backward, his wisdom soured by youthful spite.

entities.name: Throne of Death
entities.description: A throne offering the warmth and comfort of the grave.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: Home of elves stripped of their divinity.

entities.name: Tergrid
entities.description: The God of Fright, whose shadow tried to kill her as a child.

entities.name: Tergrid's Lantern
entities.description: Tergrid's lantern, which keeps her murderous shadow at bay.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: A demon who waded through a river of fire to bring death to Bretagard.

entities.name: Arni Brokenbrow
entities.description: A warrior who headbutted a troll and won.

entities.name: Birgi
entities.description: The God of Storytelling, with a well of stories and a horn that never runs dry.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane of the realms.

entities.name: Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
entities.description: Birgi's horn, which never runs dry.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The great tree of Kaldheim.

entities.name: Jorn
entities.description: The God of Winter, at home wherever snow falls.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: The God of the Tree, who knows the world from canopy to roots.

entities.name: The Prismatic Bridge
entities.description: A bridge leading to Starnheim.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: A realm awaiting those who cross the Prismatic Bridge.

entities.name: Kaldring, the Rimestaff
entities.description: A staff connected to Jorn, who collects a sliver of ice from every realm.

entities.name: The Ringhart Crest
entities.description: A crest associated with Kolvori and her family.

entities.name: Kolvori
entities.description: A woman whose love for her family knows no bounds.

entities.name: Cosmos Elixir
entities.description: The elixir to which the Skoti owe their immortality.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: An immortal people whose most guarded secret is the elixir's creation.

entities.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
entities.description: A speaker who hears the trees and trusts in the path.

entities.name: Solrun
entities.description: A Beskir warrior who maps routes.

entities.name: Beskir
entities.description: A clan of Kaldheim.

entities.name: Tuskeri
entities.description: A brave clan that blazes new trails.

entities.name: Haugar
entities.description: A Kannah wayfinder.

entities.name: Kannah
entities.description: A clan of Kaldheim.

entities.name: Skelle Mire
entities.description: A dark mire where a light is never a good sign.

entities.name: Cosmos Serpent
entities.description: A serpent who carved tunnels, leaving an aura of ferocity and growth.

entities.name: Faceless Haven
entities.description: A place everywhere and nowhere, just beyond the real.

entities.name: Ekken
entities.description: An Omenseeker navigator.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: A group of navigators.

entities.name: Light of Starnheim
entities.description: A light that shines where valkyries fly.

events.summary: The realms crash together, with Bretagard at the center of the calamity.
events.quote: The realms crashed together, with Bretagard at the center of the calamity.

events.summary: Halvar unites the spirits of all the clans into a single force.
events.quote: Halvar united the spirits of all the clans into a single, devastating force.

events.summary: Demons of Immersturm pour into Bretagard, slaughtering as they come.
events.quote: Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.

events.summary: In the past, Tergrid's shadow tried to kill her as a child.
events.quote: When Tergrid was a child, her shadow tried to kill her.

events.summary: Varragoth wades through a river of fire to bring death to Bretagard.
events.quote: "I waded through a river of fire to bring death to Bretagard."

relations.quote: Alrund's raven soars between realms; no secret is beyond his grasp.

relations.note: Her lantern keeps her shadow at bay
relations.quote: Only her lantern keeps it at bay.
Like her well of stories, Birgi's horn never runs dry.

relations.note: Came to bring death to Bretagard
relations.quote: "I waded through a river of fire to bring death to Bretagard."

relations.note: Masks of Littjara float toward it
relations.quote: The masks float downstream toward the Mirrorlake, where faces arise to wear them.

rejected.quote: "The Cosmos Serpent carved these tunnels, and his echo remains, a twisting aura of ferocity and boundless growth."
